description: This file provides utility functions for sending reminders via email and WhatsApp within a customer management system. It includes functions to send email reminders over SMTP and a stub for WhatsApp message sending via an external API.

methods.name: None send_email_reminder(recipient_email: str, subject: str, message: str)
methods.description: Sends an email reminder to a customer via SMTP, raising an HTTPException if configuration is incomplete or sending fails.

methods.name: None send_whatsapp_reminder(recipient_phone: str, message: str)
methods.description: Stub function that raises NotImplementedError, intended for sending WhatsApp reminders using external APIs in production.
